title: saiku-ui ships a patched dompurify and security-scan.yml scans advisories on a schedule

criteria.then: dompurify resolves to 3.4.17 or newer (single copy)
a job runs npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high for saiku-ui on schedule and on push, with read-only permissions
a scheduled job scans the Java tree with a version-pinned, sha256-verified osv-scanner, with read-only permissions
the dependency-review PR gate is unchanged
